excluded.reason: Batch expiry does not guarantee successful completion; several cadence choices satisfy the simplified arithmetic.
Uncalibrated confidence is presented as an endorsed review mechanism without enough qualification.
Incorrectly places allowedTools on AgentDefinition instead of query options.
The implementation already checks stop_reason; a safety cap is not intrinsically incorrect.
Infers a cumulative refund policy not specified by the scenario.
Tool descriptions alone do not enforce valid transactional identifiers.
Conflicts with the guide’s advice to communicate interacting issues together.
A path-scoped file permission does not guarantee protection through every tool such as Bash.
Plan mode versus direct execution is underspecified for this refactor.
